title: Attuned Anchors
description: Build Anchor waypoints for either Local or Global range with Permissions, Menu and HUD markers.
body:
### Mach9Games Studio ## Attuned Anchors! ![Attuned Anchors Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/329cab9b60b10451f51fa53c324bc9de04bcb7ab.png)

**Attuned Anchors** adds buildable waypoint shrines to Minecraft. Instead of placing waypoints from a map screen, players build an Anchor structure in the world, activate it, and then use it through an in-game waypoint menu and HUD. ![Waypoint Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/420428020b3bf4f8ee513027f389a5b4791ac872.png) ## Installation Install the same jar on both the client and server. - Client: required - Server: required ## Features - Buildable **Local Anchors** and **Global Anchors** - In-game waypoint HUD with distance markers - `N` menu for viewing, editing, teleporting, and managing Anchors - Admin teleport button for fast travel - Name Tag based access control - Public Anchors, private Anchors, and assigned-user Anchors - Automatic structure validation - Broken Anchors disable themselves and reactivate when repaired - Fully removed Anchors are cleaned from storage - Persistent world storage ## Anchor Types Attuned Anchors has two Anchor types with different visibility ranges. | Type | Visibility Range | Core Block | Item Frame | |---|---|---|---| | Local Anchor | < 256m | Iron Block | Ender Pearl | | Global Anchor | > 256m | Diamond Block | Eye of Ender | **Local Anchors** are short-range waypoints. By default, they are visible up to **256m** away. **Global Anchors** are long-range waypoints. They can be seen from **beyond 256m** and remain available from anywhere in the same dimension. ![Global Anchor HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef297888dc48299c444a693b6d63569b1baf982c_0.webp) ## Access Control Anchor access is controlled through **Name Tags** placed inside the Anchor barrels. - Add a default `Name Tag` to make the Anchor public. - Add renamed Name Tags with player names to make the Anchor visible only to those players. - Leave out Name Tags to keep the Anchor disabled until access is configured. - More barrels means more room for access names. ![Public Anchor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44944e3e05b41dee62e42de7ec552d328f133772_0.webp) ![Private Anchor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78729dc1fb505a842cf7c3c22b0167866fb9726b_0.webp) ## Waypoint Menu Press `N` to open the Attuned Anchors menu. From the menu, players can view available Anchors, toggle HUD visibility, inspect access, edit marker appearance, and manage Anchors they are allowed to control. ![Edit Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c5771fd099aa3376f221fd9b11944ec46bd5900.webp) ![User List](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23379e513c335c950218e16c1d511da1a0e26c90.webp) Deleting an Anchor uses a confirmation screen to prevent accidental removals. ![Delete Confirmation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd409217e9fd002dd1b27900a4fdc54e66c8e172.webp) ## Activation Build the structure, place the required item frames, then interact with one of the Anchor item frames. If the structure is valid, the Anchor is registered, its candles are managed by the mod, and it becomes visible to players with access.
Layer-by-Layer Construction Guide Anchors use a **5x5 footprint**. Build each layer centered on the core block position. ![Layer -1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb5608d8d8a6031ab97a60031bb7bf0f239f92ca.png) ![Layer 0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35afd1711ce147a61ceeb1daed75309b20c53d4a.png) ![Layer 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0300189e3d24399882eda001c9db4ab1a018ae1.png) ![Layer 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7b491965bc2e3ea2bb11a1ab3a41c298cc8ec47.png) ![Layer 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01d7c1fd5eaa724ed4ba75197a92cb0a6aa4b1d4.png) ![Layer 4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1603676db01904135b2fd6a3af3fd757f378b47.png) The item frames must contain: - Local Anchor: Ender Pearl - Global Anchor: Eye of Ender Global Anchors use glowing item frames by default.
## Commands The main command is `/anchor`, with `/an` as a shortcut. - `/anchor spawn [ [ []]]` creates a complete Anchor. - `/anchor despawn` removes the nearest registered Anchor structure within 32 blocks. - `/anchor list` shows Anchors visible to the player. - `/anchor remove` deletes the nearest registered Anchor record without breaking blocks. - `/anchor help [spawn | despawn | list | remove]` shows command help. Add this near the bottom, replacing the current **Configuration** section: ## Configuration Attuned Anchors creates its config files in: ```text config/attunedanchors/ ``` ### Main Config ```text config/attunedanchors/config.json ``` Default values: ```json { "localRadius": 256, "validationIntervalSeconds": 60, "globalSameDimensionOnly": true, "anchorNameMaxLength": 16, "localNamePrefix": "[L] ", "globalNamePrefix": "[G] " } ``` Anchor records are saved per world at: ```text data/attuned_anchors.tsv ``` Structure definitions are configurable through: ```text config/attunedanchors/structures.json ``` ## Admins and Permissions Attuned Anchors supports the Fabric Permissions API. Grant this node to give full access: ```text attunedanchors.admin ``` Individual permission nodes: | Permission | Allows | |---|---| | `attunedanchors.menu` | Open the Anchor menu | | `attunedanchors.edit` | Edit Anchor name, color, and icon | | `attunedanchors.manage` | Manage Anchor users and delete Anchors | | `attunedanchors.teleport` | Teleport to Anchors from the menu | | `attunedanchors.command.list` | Use `/anchor list` | | `attunedanchors.command.spawn` | Use `/anchor spawn` | | `attunedanchors.command.remove` | Use `/anchor remove` | | `attunedanchors.command.despawn` | Use `/anchor despawn` | If you do not use a permissions mod, fallback admins can be added here: ```text config/attunedanchors/admins.json ``` Example: ```json { "uuids": [ "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" ], "names": [ ] } ``` ```json { "uuids": [ ], "names": [ "PlayerName" ] } ```
